arguments.command:
cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/convert_pass_through.sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
DIR="/home/user/Documents/Novels/Pass Through"
OUTPUT="${DIR}/Pass_Through.epub"
# concatenate chapters
cat "$DIR"/Chapter*.txt > "$DIR/PassThrough.txt"
# convert to epub
pandoc "$DIR/PassThrough.txt" -o "$OUTPUT" --metadata title="Pass Through"
rm "$DIR/PassThrough.txt"
echo "EPUB created at $OUTPUT"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/convert_pass_through.sh
